topics.inclusion_rule: The 165-study video-to-speech population (pattern of components/M06/video-to-speech-one-to-many-decoder), classified from the full text (reference list removed) by whether text predicted from the video by a lip reader is used at inference to condition or guide speech synthesis, whether a classifier or ASR guides a diffusion sampler, and whether a lip-reader-to-TTS cascade is named. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); text used only as a training loss or as an evaluation reference does not count as use-time text; versions once.
topics.metric: LRS3 ASR WER of the generated speech

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 165-study population, classified by training-only text supervision: a CTC or ASR/text loss on the speech generator or its features, and a recognizer trained on noised or diffusion-time-conditioned spectrograms to act as a guidance classifier. Boundary: text used at inference is M07; a pretrained evaluation ASR is not supervision; full-text pattern counts, upper bound; versions once.
